items.name: Scarab Amulet
items.description: A carved lapis scarab humming with old battle-magic. Your troops strike harder.

items.name: Veil of Sands
items.description: Woven from enchanted sandstorm dust. Blows deflect blows.

items.name: Obsidian Edge
items.description: A shard of volcanic glass bound to your hero's will. Each strike cuts deeper.

items.name: Cursed Eye of Set
items.description: The god's gaze grants savage fury — but rots the bearer's guard. Cannot be discarded.

items.name: Serpent Band
items.description: A coiling bronze band. The serpent spirit inside quickens your warriors' legs.

items.name: Oathstone Amulet
items.description: A river pebble carved with a family oath. Men fight harder under it.

items.name: Bearhide Cloak
items.description: Heavy, warm, and stitched with bronze rings.

items.name: Barrow Blade
items.description: A bronze sword from a barrow king's grave. Still sharp. Still hungry.

items.name: Drowned Crown
items.description: The crown of a king who went into the mere rather than kneel. It remembers the old tunnels.

items.name: Hale Signet
items.description: Your cousin's seal ring, given in friendship. The wolf of House Hale quickens your march.

items.name: Wolfpelt Boots
items.description: Soft-soled and silent. The column keeps pace with the scouts.

items.name: Greyfang Helm
items.description: A troll-chief's iron cap, hammered to fit a human skull.

items.name: Listening Shard
items.description: A splinter of violet crystal. Held to the ear, it is silent. Held to the ground, it is not.

items.name: The Warm Stone
items.description: Always the temperature of a sleeping body. It has a pulse, if you wait long enough. The soldiers will not say why they refuse to carry it.
